item.title: −60% Query Time — Iceberg Lakehouse Migration for a SaaS Analytics Platform
item.description: Migrated a Hive-partitioned S3 data lake to Apache Iceberg with a CDK-deployed medallion architecture. Athena query time dropped 60%, S3 API costs dropped 90%.

item.title: 600K Records/Week at <0.1% Failure — Airflow ETL for an E-Commerce Data Team
item.description: Built a production Airflow pipeline on MWAA to replace a fragile cron-based ETL. 600,000+ weekly records processed reliably. SLA misses eliminated.
